# Agentic Development Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `.agentic/core/operating-manual.md` for the shared workflow.

- Plan non-trivial work in one ticket before edits.
- Keep changes within approved file ownership and preserve user configuration.
- Report actual checks run; do not imply tests or reviews that did not happen.
- Use the reusable prompts for planning, review, security review, and build fixes.
